༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi yum bka' rgyas pa byin rlabs myur 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi yum bka' rgyas pa byin rlabs myur 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha'i rdo rje rtag tu rol pa rnal 'byor ma yi gtso// chags pas kun chags bcu drug lang tsho nam yang mi yol ba// 'jig rten mun par zhugs pa'i dbugs 'byin phun tshogs 'dzag pa yi// dpal gyi dga' char chen po'i gnas gyur de la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam snang mdzad ma'i byin rlabs kyis// snying la shis brjod ma byas par// rig byed rtsom la 'jug pa ni// tshangs pas rigs pa min bsam byas// 'dir bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi yum bka' rgyas pa lha mo bco lnga'i bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod pas/ gdod nas dag pa'i yul chen po la sogs par rnal 'byor gyi yo byad tshang bas bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ bla ma rigs kyi bdag por bltas pa'i sgom bzlas bya'o// de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du padma dmar po 'dam ma lnga pa'i lte ba la oṃ baṃ dmar po/ 'dab ma la g.yon skor gyis haṃ yauṃ sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu/ phaṭ phaṭ dud kha/ dpa' mo drug gi rang bzhin/ mthe bong la oṃ hāḥdakar po/ mdzub mo la na ma hi ser po/ gung mo la swa ha hu dmar po/ srin lag la bau ṣa ṭa he nag po/ mthe'u chung la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥmathing kha/ sen mo'i ngos la phaṭ haṃ ljang khu/ dpa' bo drug gi rang bzhin/ lag pa'i bol la 'di dag nyid kyi gzugs brnyan/ lag pa'i sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams rim pa bzhin/ ltung byed/ gsod byed/ 'gugs byed/ gar gyi dbang phyug padma dra ba can ma rnams kyi rang bzhin no// de nas chang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'bul zhing nyer mchod bza' btung thams cad/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badzra wā rā hi baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ārya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bidye shwa ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bhū ta bha yā ba he mahā badzre huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ badzrā sa ne a dzi ti a pa rā dzi te ba shaṃ ka ri ne tra bhrā ma ṇī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bi ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ trā sa ni mā ra ṇi su pra bhe da ni pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dza ye ba dzi ye dzaṃ bha ni staṃ bha ni mo ha nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra wā rā hi mahā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kyis phul/ yig brgya bzlas/ de nas lag mthil du yod pa'i khu ba srin lag gis blangs nas snying mgo bo rnams su hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ brjod pas byug cing ngo bo lha/ rnam pa yi ger bzhugs pa de bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ lhag ma bdud rtsi'i nang du blug cing*/ mdun du yam las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a las padma'i snod dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba thod pa gsum gyi sgyed bu la gnas pa'i nang du/ oṃ āṃ trāṃ khāṃ hūm̐/ lāṃ māṃ bāṃ tāṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga rlung gis bskul bas me sbar/ thod pa bsros pas rdzas rnams zhu ba nyi ma 'char ka'i kha dog can/ de'i steng du dngul chu'i mdog can gyi hūm̐ las byung ba'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po thur du lta ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu bas ro gcig par gyur pa rnams/ dbyangs gsal brjod/ ā li g.yon skor/ kā li g.yas skor du song ba yongs su gyur pas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge brtsegs mar gnas pa de dag las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas 'od du zhu nas yi ge gsum la rim pa bzhin thim/ oṃ yig zhu bas sbyangs/ āḥyig gis mang por spel/ hūm̐ gis sbar ba dang bdud rtsir byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mtheb srin sbyar bas cung zad myang*/ des kha dag par bya'o/ de nas rang nyid skad gcig gis bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i baṃ yig gis sprul pa'i 'od kyis lha mo bco lnga'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar pheṃ/

'bar ba'i phyag rgya bca'/ de nas cang te'u dang dril bu la sogs pa'i rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ mkha' khams chos kyi 'byung gnas nas// rigs ldan ma dang pho nya mo// dngos gcig yid ngor rnam mang ba'i// mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan 'dren no// snying rje'i gzugs mtshar khyed rnams la// snying nas skyabs zhus bdag cag rnams// snying brtser gzigs nas byang chub kyi// snying por drang phyir gshegs su gsol// de dag la dmigs nas/ rang bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos par// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// rgyal ba kun gyi snying po mchog /de la phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// ces phyag bya/ oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ka gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shaptas mchod/ bdag gis thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas// byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rangs ba// sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jig byed pa'i// spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni// mi bgyid pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi// nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*// rgyal ba'i sras pos bsags pa'i dge ba gang*// de dag la ni rjes su yi rangs zhing*// byang chub tu ni bdag gis yang dag bsngo// sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog gsum po la// dngos po kun gyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi// byang chub tu ni sems bskyed de bzhin du// bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi// 'gro ba'i don phyir sangs rgyas 'phrin las rnams// ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis byed gyur cig /rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas badzra muḥ'akhor lo bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig thog mtha' 'dra bas/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig

sems can thams cad kyi don du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang bsgrub par bya/ de'i ched du sgom pa'i rim pa la 'jug par bya'o snyam pas rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa la/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas// kun kyang mnyam pa nyid du gsal// oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharm+māḥswa bha wa shuddho3 haṃ/ dngos po dang dngos po med par dmigs pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba la gnas par bya'o// de nas sgyu ma lta bur langs pa'i rang lus kyi lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug cing*/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du lta ba'i chos 'byung bsnol ma 'od kyi rang bzhin gyi nang du padma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang bzhi pa rim pa gnyis kyi lte ba la tsha zer can gyi khar dus mtshan dang 'jigs byed byi chings su bsnol ba dang*/ 'dab ma rnams la nyi ma dang dbugs bral re/ 'og gi grur yang de bzhin gyi dbus mar baṃ/ steng du aṃ/ 'og gi grur aḥpadma nang ma'i phyogs g.yon skor du/ iṃ uṃ eṃ oṃ phyi'i phyogs la aṃ kaṃ tsaṃ ṭaṃ/ mtshams me nas g.yas skor du taṃ baṃ yaṃ shaṃ/ de dag las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis don gnyis byas/ rang bzhin gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad bsdus te slar de nyid la thim par gyur/ de rnams rim pa bzhin yongs su gyur pa las/ rang gi sems bde ba chen po rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i skur bzhengs pa bhandhu ri ka ltar dmar ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma/ chos thams cad gcig tu ston pa'i zhal gcig mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ 'khor ba la rgyab phyogs pa'i phyir cher gcus pa'i 'gying bag dang bcas pa'i bzhin ras g.yon gyi nam mkhar phyogs pa nas dus gsum mnyam pa'i spyan gsum gyen du gzigs pa/ 'ching ba thams cad dang bral bas dbu skra bung ba ltar nag pa gsil bur 'phyang zhing*/

phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo nyid yin pas 'khor lo dang thod pa'i cod pan dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ se ral kha dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ thod pa'i dum bu'i ske rags can/ zhe sdang gi tshul gyis zhe sdang 'joms pas phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje gri gug pus mo'i thad nas thur du bsnun pa/ 'dod chags kyis 'dod chags sbyong ba kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po he ru ka'i rang bzhin g.yon gyi phrag par bkal ba/ gti mug gis gti mug sel ba g.yon pa'i phyag gis padma'i snod zhal sgor gzungs nas nam mkha' 'jo ba/ rnam par 'gyings pas nga rgyal gzhom pa/ dregs pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi mgrin pa nas gtubs pa'i mgo rdo rje'i thag pa la brgyus pa'i ga sha phrag dog gis phrag dog brlag par byed pa bdud kyi yul ngan par ston pa'i 'ja' tshon gyi sprin nam mkha'i khams khyab par 'gyed pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su chags pa'i rol mo la bskul bas gar dgu'i nyams skyong ba/ sgrib pa thams cad kyis spangs pa chen pos gcer mo/ snying rje'i cha yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtogs pa chen pos bcu drug pa'i gang ba la rtag tu gnas pa/ mchog tu dga' ba thams cad sbyin pas nu ma zung cher 'bur ba'i stod rgyas shing sked pa phra la smad sbom pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum nas thams cad skyes pa mtshon par byed pas rus sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho la khrag 'dzag pa'i bha ga rdul gyis 'og rkang mthil dang snying stobs kyis steng tshangs pa'i yul gang ba ni gzung 'dzin gyi rlung bcom pa las yin pas glang po che'i sna zhags lta bu'i zhabs g.yas brkyang gis dus mtshan dang 'jigs byed brdzis pa/ 'od gsal gyi mes chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas pa'i nam mkha' la sbyor ba'i brdar me 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i steng gi nam mkhar mkha' spyod ma dkar mo 'phur ba'i tshul can/ 'og gi grur sa 'og spyod ma dur phag khros pa'i gdong mthing nag phyag gnyis thugs kar sdigs mdzub bcas te sa 'og gi gdon gzir ba sbrul gyi rgyan can/

nang ma'i shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ phyi ma'i shar du khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba can g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon bsngo ba/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa gri gug 'phyar zhing thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa gcer mo skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pa pad nyi'i steng ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa thod pa dang rdo rje 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ lha de thams cad kyi spyi bor sku rdo rje'i ngo bo oṃ/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo āḥ snying gar thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūm̐/ gtso mo'i lte bar oṃ baṃ phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yauṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ khar hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ sreg byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ tsaṇḍi ka dud kha/ thams cad gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ro'i gdan la rol ba'o// thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i nas sngar bzhin spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa'i 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi gzugs bla ma he ru ka'i tshul du bzhugs pa'i phyag g.yon gyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i padma'i snod gzung g.yas ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur nas dbu brgyan par gyur/

rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i me tog ma la sogs pa'i lha mo nam mkha'i khams khyab pa rnams kyis/ sbyin pa la sogs thams cad kyis ni 'gro ba'i yid kyi 'dod pa mchog ni kun rdzogs mdzad// he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro ma sogs rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer thams cad phye mar brlag /gang zhig 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhing bla ma rgyal ba'i ye shes 'byung gnas mthar phyin mdzad// de ni snying rje chen po'i dbang gyur 'phags pa rnams kyis rtag tu myur bar bkra shis yin// rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na// rdo rje rin chen bla na med// rdo rje chos ni glur blangs pas// rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur// ces bkra shis kyi glu len cing gar dang bcas pas rang ming gi mchod pa 'bul bar bsams nas/ oṃ badzra puṣpe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sogs rnam lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod phyi/ gzugs gsum rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad// bde chen gcig las du ma'i gar// brtan g.yo'i rnam pa thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// oṃ badzra rū pa badzra rū pa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sgra gsum he ru ka dpal mgon// bde chen= rol mo dbyangs snyan thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor/ shapta/ dri gsum rdo rje nyin mor byed// bde= dri zhim byug spos thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor/ gandhe/ ro gsum padma gar gyi dbang*// bde= ro mchog bza' btung thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor/ rāsya/ reg gsum don yod grub pa dngos/ bde= bsam yas bde 'byung thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor// sparshe/ nang*/ de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi/ lcags kyu lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga// dngos grub kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga thob shog /sarba pañtsa a mri ta pū dza khā hi zhais ming med mthe bong sbyar bas bdud rtsi myang*/ gsang ba/ lha dang mi yi bde ba ni// bsdus byas rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// bcu drug char yang mi phod pa'i// dga' ba bla na med pas mchod// de kho na nyid kyi mchod de/

hūṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang sgyur las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag bsnyems ma// rmugs byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa pham zhing skem par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug khyod la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes pas bstod de/ ji tsam gzhan du mi g.yeng ba de tsam du sgom mo// de nas snying kha'i baṃ gyi mthar/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa'i sngags bkod nas bzla'o/

de'i tshe sngags 'phreng las 'od zer gyi sna la bcom ldan 'das ma'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa ci yang 'phros pas nam mkha'i khams khyab te des sems can thams cad rang rang gi skal ba bzhin du btul nas/ slar sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// 'khor la/ oṃ aṃ aḥ.i u e o a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha swāhā/ zhes bzlas so// de ni 'dir 'phreng ba'i sngags su'ang bzhag go /de nas bza' bca' ji snyed pa/ khyad par nya dang sha chang gi rigs rnams bdud rtsi bzhin byin gyis brlabs te/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ gu ru shrī badzra yo gi nī/ ā kaḍḍha ya ā kaḍḍha ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ bandha ya bandha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sarba badzra ḍā ki nī hri da ya/ a pa to ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī swa bha wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de la/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin pa dyaṃ/ añtsa mā nāṃ/ nyer mchod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ a ā sogs lag pa g.yon ā li las zla ba/ ka sogs lag pa g.yas kā li las nyi ma kha sbyor gyi bar du hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥsarba dharmāḥpa ra spa ra a nu pra biṣṭaḥsarba dharmāḥ.a tyantu a nu pra biṣṭaḥsarba dharmāḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i thal mo/ de'i steng du gtong ma bzhag bzhes pa'i don du/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// de gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /de nas lag pa pad kor byas te/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥzhes lan gsum brjod pas mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa thams cad tha mi dad par bsam mo// oṃ ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadzra ḍā ki? nī sa ma ya st+waṃ dri ṣya hoḥ

ye shes pa rnams la phul/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma/ oṃ dur khrod dang ni shing gcig dang*// ri bo dang ni ri sul phug /grong dang gzhi mdo zhing dang ni// khyad par du ni khyim stong dang*// sems can gnas dang thang dang ni// khyad par du ni chu la gnas// nag po drag po drag chen po// lha sbyin mnyam du brten pa dang*// nag po rtsigs dang mi sdug dang*// rga las 'das dang log 'dren dang*// rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang*// 'jigs byed ma dang u ma dang*// rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ma dang*// mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma// nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo// nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma// dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo// drag tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo// 'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma// 'jigs byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma// drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo// mche ba gtsigs dang thod chen ma// thod 'phreng 'phreng dang kha ṭwāṃ ga /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta can// rdo rje de ni gzhu can ma// de nyid chen mo mkha' 'gro lnga// las kun rjes su sgrub byed pa// sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen mo// de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen mo// rdul med rnal 'byor sbyin pa mo// rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yin// thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig /zhes spyan drangs pas dur khrod brgyad// nyer bzhi'i yul gyi zhing skyong za byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma drug cu rtsa bzhi/ 'khor bsam mi khyab pas bskor te/ dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu bzhugs par bsam la/ oṃ ka ka kadhya na/ ba ba bandha na/ kha kha khā da na/ sarba duṣṭa naṃ/ ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ che ge mo'i dgos pa mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ dzaḥswāhā/ zhes phul/ gtor ma la kha phru btab/ oṃ bhakṣa sarba yo gī shwa rī huṃ hūm̐ dzaḥswāhā/ gshegs/ sngar bzhin mchod nas/ gang zhig 'jigs rung dur khrod chen por phaṭ phaṭ rngam pa'i sgra sgrog cing*// mkha' 'gro za byed mun pa'i nang na zla shar lta bur rab tu 'bar// hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod sha za ro langs ma mo'i tshogs rnams skrag mdzad ma// gsang sngags gsang mdzod mnga' bdag bde chen rgyal ba'i yum gyi sku la 'dud//

ces bstod nas/ dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ zhing rgya mtsho kun na chos kyi rje// rje thog ma dbus mtha'i 'jig rten mgon// mgon gcig la gcig thug bka' babs brgyud// brgyud byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs// lus 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i sprul pa'i sku// ngag thams cad skad kyi longs spyod rdzogs// yid bde stong kha sbyor chos kyi skur// 'tshang da lta rgya bar byin gyis rlobs// e 'khor lo waṃ bde sdom pa'i dpal// dpal mchog gi dang po'i rdor sems dngos// dngos dngos med phyogs bral rgyal ba'i yab// yab byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs// lus 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i sprul pa'i sku// ngag thams cad skad kyi longs spyod rdzogs// yid bde stong kha sbyor chos kyi skur// 'tshang da lta rgya bar byin gyis rlobs// chos thams cad 'byung ba'i rnam thar sgo// sgo bzhi ldan shes rab phar phyin yum// yum chos sku ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// ma byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs// lus 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i sprul pa'i sku// ngag thams cad skad kyi longs spyod rdzogs// yid bde stong kha sbyor chos kyi skur// 'tshang da lta rgya bar byin gyis rlobs// rten bha ga'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams lha// lha sgyu ma chen mo nyid kyi 'phrul// 'phrul chu zlas dpe mtshon blon mo'i tshogs// tshogs byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs// lus 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i sprul pa'i sku// ngag thams cad skad kyi longs spyod rdzogs// yid bde stong kha sbyor chos kyi skur// 'tshang da lta rgya bar byin gyis rlobs// yul gdod nas grub pa'i nyir bzhi'i bdag /bdag med pa'i dur khrod rol mkhan las// las kun mdzad za byed mkha' 'gro'i sde// sde byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs// lus 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i sprul pa'i sku// ngag thams cad skad kyi longs spyod rdzogs// yid bde stong kha sbyor chos kyi skur// 'tshang da lta rgya bar byin gyis rlobs// badzra muḥzhes brjod pas mgron ye shes pa bdag la bstim/

'jig rten pa rang gnas su gshegs par bsams nas rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo rnams me long la has btab pa bzhin gtso mo/ de snying ga'i baṃ la/ de mas rim gyis sgra ris/ de yal nas stong pa nyid du zhugs par bsam/ de nas sgyu ma lta bu'i blos langs nas dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'khod par shog /bkra shis bya'o// ༈ sgrub pa la 'jug par 'dod pas/ sgrub pa gzhan gyi de nyid/ nyer sgrub bdag gi de nyid/ sgrub chen rnal 'byor gyi de nyid gsum las/ dang po ni/ chang byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar sngar bzhin la/ me long la sindhu ra brdal/ gser gyi smyu gus chang gis chos 'byung bsnol ma'i nang padma 'dab ma brgyad/ de'i nang du drug yi ge dang bcas pa bri/ de yang steng 'og shar nub kyi g.yas g.yon du'am/ bzhir byed na gtso mo'i steng 'og la'o// stegs bu'i steng mañdzi khar thod pa chang gis bkang ba la bkod dar dmar po'i gur phub/ mtha' mar mchod pa lha grangs kyis bskor ro// de nas maṇḍal de oṃ swa bha wa sngags kyis sbyangs pas rtsa ba phra ba sogs gar gyi rol pa zhes pa la rang gi sems zer ba bzhag pa tsam byas/ de nas chos 'byung gi phyi'i khor yug tu dur khrod brgyad nyer bzhi'i yul gyi zhing skyong za byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma drug cu rtsa bzhi 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i nas/ rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga thob shog/ nye snying dang bcu bzhi'i sa bon re la na maḥ btags pas mchod/ sarba pañtsa a mri ta pū dza kha hi sa khor yug bar/ sngar bzhin de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa byas/ bstod pa ni/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor can ngos bde ba'i bris// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan sku dmar ba// blo gros nyi ma 'bum sde dus gcig tu// 'char ka'i mdangs su nges la phyag 'tshal bstod// cung zad mche gtsigs spyan gsum gyen gzigs shing*// 'gying bcas g.yon gyi mkha' la gdong phyogs pa// chos kun gcig la du ma'i blor 'chel bas// 'og tu lhung ba rnams la khros pa snyam// bcu drug lang tshos sgeg cing nyams dgu'i gar// rgyal rnams bstan pa 'gog la shugs ches dgongs// rigs sngas phyag rgyas bkab kyang 'dod ldan bzhin// rgya skyegs khu bas byugs rnams da dung snang*// rmongs pa dug 'dzin 'di kha bdud rtsi'i dpyid// ye shes ches cher bskyed nus nyid ston la// gri gug bsnun dang kha ṭwāṃ gar 'khyud dang*// pad snod kyis 'jo ga sha 'od sprin bkye// g.yas brkyang sor mo'i rtse tshun nyi mas dang*// g.yon bskum zla bas tshangs pa'i yul gang ba// gzung dang 'dzin pa bcom pa'i mthu stobs su// gdan dang nyin mor byed pas gsal por bstan// khyod zhabs bsten las sgrib gnyis bsregs gyur 'di// rab gtum me lce'i 'phreng ba 'khrug 'dis sam// nyid ka chos rab rnam 'byed mthar phyin pa'i// zhugs chen lag pas yin nam 'phyang mo yug

/khyod gzugs chu nang zla bzhin steng 'og snang*// khyad par 'khor lo'i dbang phyug zur mig mda'i// 'ben du gtsugs pa bcu gnyis lha mo'i gar// srid zhi'i dngos po kun la phyag 'tshal bstod// khyod nyid sangs rgyas de bzhin bdag cag la'ang*// khyod kyis mdzad par 'os ces bskul ba'i tshig /khyod drung kho nar bgyid pa'ang lugs yin pas// khyod myur 'dod pa 'grub pa'i mchog 'di stsol// zhes bstod/ gnyis pa ni tshad med bzhi las brtsams te bzlas/ de dus mdun bskyed bskul ba'i spro bsdu byas/ des lha mo rnams bde ba rgyas pas bha ga nas rdul 'dzags ka pā la gang bar bsam mo// gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi de nyid ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang thob pa'i gang zag gis zhag re la tshogs re bya ba'am/ yang na zla ba re/ tha na lo re la tshogs re ma byas na bza' ba'i dam tshig nyams par gsungs pas dam tshig bsrung ba'i phyir tshogs bya'o// de yang slob dpon dang rnal 'byor pa thams cad phyag rgya yod na tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ slob dpon las gzhan la med na tshogs kyi mchod pa/ thams cad la med na dpa' bo'i ston mo'am dpa' mo'i ston mo 'di gnyis gtso bo'i phyag rgya mtshon par byed pa re dgos par bshad do// dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyir/ mi g.yo mgon po 'dra ba'i 'bag mig ya gcig steng*/ cig shos 'og tu lta ba gos sngon po gyon dbyug pa lag tu thogs pa gcig sgo rtsar bzhag nang du lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i ro'i dbyibs kyi gdan nam dur khrod kyi ras la bris pa'o// stag lpags bting*/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon spyan drangs stag lpags kyi khar chos 'byung gru gsum pa nyis rtseg byas/ de'i dbus su thod pa lnga la sgron ma dang bdud rtsi lnga phye ste bzhag pa'am/ thod pa gcig tu dam tshig gi ril bu sbyar ba'i chang blug pa gzhag tshogs kyi yo byad ci yod pa de la bskor/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma bsham/ rnal 'byor pa rnams phyir khrus byas rgan pa cig sngar 'ongs nas/ khro bo la gsol ba 'di skad gdab bo// kye dam tshig mdzes pa 'jam pa sngo mdog thugs// 'khor ba las rgyal dpa' bo 'dus pa'i tshogs mthong ngo*// rin chen bkod pa'i dbyug pa phyag na bsnams pa kye// rnal 'byor ma rnams dbus su bdag mchi sgo dbyer gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ des bum dbang thob bam rtag pa'i brda ston/ brda lan thebs pa nang du btang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i go rims sam ston mo gnyis la gral rim pa byas/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog phul la/ sa ma ti ma ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas gzhan gyi de nyid dang bdag gi de nyid sgom/ de nas las rdor gyis slob dpon nas brtsams te thams cad la spyi bo dang snying gar dri'i thig le bya/ nyer mchod lnga go rim bzhin du 'bul/ de nas byin rlabs bskyed pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis sems kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis gang bar bsam/ ngag gis snying po dang 'phreng sngags 'don/ slob ma rnams kyi lte ba'i dbus su yi ge a dmar po tsha ba rno ba bsams la rtse gcig tu gtad cing*/ spro na rol mo dang bcas te/ hūm̐/ thugs zung 'jug rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// gsung chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad pa// sku rnam pa kun ldan tshogs kyi mchog /skyabs gsum gyi 'dus pa bla ma rje// 'khor brgyud pa'i bla ma nyil li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khrol lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'ur ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs ling nge nge*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas 'di la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal nas kyang*// yab khyed dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub zhu// dkyil 'khor gyi padma'i snying po kun// ris med pa rgyal ba'i ze 'brus gang*// dngos grub kyi zil mngar ci dang ci// yid bzhin du 'byung ba lhag pa'i lha// 'khor yi dam lha tshogs nyil li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khrol lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'ur ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs ling nge nge*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas 'di la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal nas kyang*// lha khyed dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub zhu// nang ye shes nyi ma zla ba'i rdzu// bar chad kyi mun pa mthar byed cing*// yid skyob kyi snang ba kun ston pa// yum rdo rje btsun mo rigs lnga'i sde// 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyil li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khrol lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'ur ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs ling nge nge*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas 'di la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal nas kyang*// ma khyed dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub zhu// khong bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo rlag byed du// dpal rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snying rje'i stobs// lha mi bzad khros pa dpa' bo'i sde// mgon mahā kā la lcam dral la// 'khor dregs pa'i lha srin nyil li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khrol lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'ur ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs ling nge nge*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas 'di la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal nas kyang*// mgon khyed dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub zhu//

des mkha' 'gro ma'i byin rlabs khyad par can phebs te/ sku phebs pas 'phar ba dang 'dar ba dang*/ gar bsgyur ba la sogs pa 'byung*/ gsung phebs pas saṃskṛ ta'i skad du chos smra/ thugs phebs pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes la stim gyis gnas par 'gyur ro// de nas slob dpon gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang gis gsang gtor byas nas lag pa g.yon pa bkab

oṃ yig gis sbyangs bar bya'o// lag pa g.yas pa bkab āḥyig gis rtogs par bya'o// snyim pa bkab ste hūm̐ yig gis sbar ba dang zhu bar bya'o// de nas/ hūṃ dbyings srid zhi kun tu 'char ba'i ma// dpal rdo rje yan lag ma mo'i 'phrul// mtshan kun ldan ye shes ka pā la// de bsam gyis mi khyab nam mkha' tsam// ā ra li rnal 'byor gyi 'dus pa la// 'dod yon gyi longs spyod mi zad pa// ha hoḥhrīḥkha dog dri ro'i tshogs// mchog rnam pa kun ldan stong pa'i dpyid// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyangs rtogs spar bas na// dpal mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i gnas// sa hā dza so so rang rig gis// kha sbyor gyi 'khor lo gcig tu bsdam// zhes byin gyis brlabs pas las kyi rdo rjes phud lngar bcad pa'i tshogs phud dang po 'bul ba la thugs gtad par zhu ces brjod nas/ hūm̐/ rje srid zhi'i phan pa thams cad du// chu zla bzhin 'gog pa med shar ba// dpal dang po'i mgon po bla ma'i zhabs// bka' brgyud kyi rje btsun rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du sbar ste 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tsho rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol ba'i// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer ni// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu// tshogs phud gnyis pa la/ nye snying 'phreng sngags dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la phul/ gsum pa/ hūm̐/ zhi ba dang khro chags thams cad pa// sgyu 'phrul gyi zlos gar la shar nas// dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i mgon mdzad pa// yi dam gyi lha tshogs rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du sbar ste 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tsho rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol ba'i// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer ni// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu/

bzhi pa/ hūm̐/ 'khor 'das kyi ngo mtshar ma lus pa// gnyis med las gnyis su ston byed pa'i// sras rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum// dpa' bo dang ḍā ki? rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du sbar ste 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tsho rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol ba'i// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer ni// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu/ lnga pa/ hūm̐/ bdud tshogs la bdud dang chos par gnyen// snying rje las rnam pa thams cad pa// khrag 'thung gi rgyal po dga' mar bcas// dam can gyi chos skyong rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du sbar ste 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tsho rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol ba'i// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer ni// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu// 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma phul/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma mi g.yo bas sna drangs te drag sngags bgrang zhing de'i rjes su 'brang bas phyir bskyal/ rnal 'byor ma gcig gis mar me chu ldag me long khyer la sgor bsdad/ gtor skyel log pa dang phyi nas bgegs 'jug srid pas sna la me long bstan/ de nas mar me lta/ de nas chu ldag brul te khar byin/ de nas nang du zhugs te/ las kyi rdo rjes skyes pa'i thod pa dum bu gcig pa chang gis bkang nas/ gzigs shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom bya mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa dang*// rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs nas gsol// zhes pa bla ma la phul/ bla mas lag pas kor zhing g.yon pa bzed/

g.yas pa steng du ba dan gsum par byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i chos kyi mchog /'dod chags dri ma med pa 'di// gzung 'dzin rnam par grol ba yi// de bzhin nyid na bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes pas blang*/ mtheb srin gyis snying gar yi dam/ mgrin par mkha' 'gro/ spyi bor bla ma bsams nas gtor/ de nas sems kyi rgyal po a yod pa la mchod pa'i bsam pas btung ngo*// mthar gyi de lta bus drang zhing blang*/ de nas sha de nas bshos sogs btang zhing glu gar dang*/ kun tu ru'i mchod pa dang*/ bza' ba'i yo byad rnams la ci rigs par longs spyod do// lhag ma las byas pa'i gtor ma spos reng mar me me tog gis brgyan pa la kha phru btab pa dang*/ lhag rul thams cad bsdus pa snod gtsang mar chu dang bsres pa gcig byas pa'i dang po/ hūm̐/ ma rdo rje btsun mo khros pa'i gzugs// 'khor gnas dang pho nya 'jig rten pa// dam tshig dang sha za'i ḍā ki? ma// mdangs dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang khra// lus glog 'gyu med dpung 'u ru ru// ngag shugs glu shud po di ri ri// yid sangs rgyas bstan la dung nge nge*// las srid gsum nyul la shar rar// mtho nam mkha'i dbyings nas bya ra byed// dam nyams pa'i steng du thog tu 'bab// bar dur khrod kun tu rgyu zhing 'phur// dgra tho lum 'bar ba'i ro ru za// dma' rgya mtsho'i gting nas gyen du rgyug /mi dam nyams bsgral nas khrag la 'thung*// nad brgyad khri bzhi stong kun gyi bdag /pho mtshar po kun gyi snying la 'jug /mo 'chor mo thams cad zhe yis gnon// gnas dben par sgom pa'i drod tshad nyul// khyed dgyes pa'i lhag gtor bshams nas 'bul// nged skal ldan dga' ba'i dngos grub zhu// oṃ u tstshiṣṭa bhakṣe bhyaḥswāhā/ gnyis pa kha 'bar ma'i sngags la de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod pa'i sham bu can gyis yi dwags rnams la sbyin no// gzhon nu ma mchod pa ni/

yul gyi bu mo gtsang ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga la sogs pa'i grangs ci tsam 'os pa bsags khrus byas rang gi khyim la kha ltas pa'i gral bya/ dri zhim po'i byug pa li khri'i thig le dgod/ me tog gi 'phreng ba dang spos bdug /nya sha la sogs pa'i sha dang bcas pa'i bza' bca' myos byed la sogs pa'i btung ba byin gyis brlabs te sbyin pa'o// de dus de dag lag pa gnyis mnyed na yi dam ma mnyes pas nad dang sdug bsngal 'byung*/ skad cig la gad mo rgod na nad kyis 'chi ba/ ngu mig phur na myur du 'chi ba/ zung sdebs la gdong phyogs na rtsod pa 'byung*/ rgyab phyogs pas lta zhing sen mo 'cha' na shas ma tshim pa slar yang sbyin dgos pa ma sbyin na nad/ glu dang rol mo byed rgod na rgyal po chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa/ chang 'thungs nas gar bro byed na yul du nad chen po 'byung*/ ston mo la mi lta bar phyogs su lta na spyod pa nyams pas lha bdag la 'khrugs pa/ phan tshun gtam la 'jug pa dang phan tshun rgod na rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga nyams pa'i skyon/ zos ma thag skyug na smyo ba/ 'gro ba'i tshe rgyab kyi phyogs su lta na las slar yang brtsam dgos pa/ sa la rkang pa nyed na gnas las 'pho ba/ babs nas phan tshun g.yul 'gyed pa rnams ngan la/ de dag mi byed na bzang*/ des las 'grub pa yin no// rang nus pa dang ldan par gyur pas zab mo brda'i dbang gis gzhan rjes su 'dzin 'dod cing slob mas gsol ba yang dang yang btab pa ji skad bshad pas dkyil 'khor dang bdag bsgrubs te/ der slob ma khrus byas 'dud pa la sngags kyi sgor sems bskyed pa'i phyir/ khyod kyi bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyis shig/ ces brjod nas/ sa ma ya a zhes brjod du bcug pas/ de'i sems snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par gyur to// de nas slob dpon gyis de'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/

su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes byin gyis brlabs pas slar sems de zla ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam par gyur to// de nas slob mas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag la de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ bdud rtsi lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ rin po che lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par spro na/ dngos grub blang ba bzhin/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba lan gsum btab/ bcom ldan 'das ma go cha dang bcas par bskyed/ slob dpon gyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i sku dpral ba'i oṃ las sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs 'od zer dkar nar gyi byung*/ phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad du song nas/ de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa slar log slob ma'i lus la thim par gyur/ rol mo dang bcas pas spos bdug 'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das// mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom// sangs rgyas sku ni bla med pa// da lta nyid du 'bab par shog /oṃ ā bāe sha ya a ā/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs 'od zer dmar nar gyis byung*/ phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad du song nas/ de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa slar log slob ma'i ngag la thim par bsam/ sgra yis tshul las nges 'byung rnams// dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul ba// sangs rgyas gsung ni bla med pa// da lta nyid du 'bab par shog

/āḥ.ā be sha ya a a/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs 'od zer sngo nar gyis byung*/ phyogs bcu zhing khams thams cad du song nas/ de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa slar log slob ma'i yid la thim par bsam/ mkha' 'gro kun dngos sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /sangs rgyas thugs ni bla med pa// da lta nyid du 'bab par shog /hūm̐ ā be sha ya a āḥ ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas ka pa la'i bdud rtsi gtad de/ rje btsun mgon po bdud rtsi dngos// bdud rtsi rje btsun mgon rang bzhin// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// sus rten grol bar 'gyur ro kye// he ru ka dpal bdud rtsi dngos// bdud rtsi he ru ka'i rang bzhin// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// sus rten grol bar 'gyur ro kye// mkha' 'gro ma ni bdud rtsi dngos// bdud rtsi mkha' 'gro ma'i rang bzhin// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// sus rten grol bar 'gyur ro kye// zhes cung zad myang du bcug ye shes kyi byin dbab/ phebs pa'i rtags 'byung*/ de nas/ sindū ra'i dkyil 'khor bstan pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i lha tshogs mngon sum du gyur par bsam/ de zhu ba'i thig le gnas gsum du bkod/ thod pa lag pa g.yas su/ 'phreng ba'am mda' gzhu g.yon du/ sna tshogs rdo rje dbus/ nor bu spyi bor/ phag zhal gtad de/ dbang po gang dang gang lam gyur// de dang de yi rang bzhin 'gro// mchog tu mnyam bzhag sbyor ba yi// thams cad sangs rgyas rang bzhin 'gyur// zhes pas so// dbang po kun las byung ba yi// dam tshig thod pa zhes byar brjod// mdzes ma 'phreng ba zhes bshad de// de kho na nyid dbu rgyan ming*// gtsug gi nor bur dbang bskur ro// sangs rgyas zhes bya rjes gnang yin// he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba'o// bum dbang du go na thod pas bde ba chen po'i rdo rje'i dam tshig

'phreng ba'am mda' gzhus stong pa/ dril bu rgya gram gnyis su med pa'i phyag rgya'i dam tshig nor bus brtul zhugs/ phag zhal rjes gnang du rig pa yin la/ de la slar thod pa la 'phreng ba sna tshogs rdo rje bkod/ phag zhal de'i khar nor bu de'i 'og tu bkod de dbang po sogs brjod pas gsang dbang go ste/ thod pa lus zhes bya ba ste// 'phreng ba rkang pa'i ming can yin// dbu rgyan bha ga zhes byar brjod// sangs rgyas khu ba zhes brjod de// gtsug gi nor bu bde bar bshad// rdo rje padma'i dbang bskur ba'o// zhes/ thod pa lus dkyil/ rkang pa liṅka/ dbu rgyan bha ga sangs rgyas der bsrubs pa'i khu ba/ gtsug gi nor bu myang bas bde ba la longs spyod pa'o// yang de la/ thod pa la 'phreng ba bkod/ de'i khar sna tshogs rdo rje bzhag phag zhal dang nor bu de'i mtha' skor te dbang po sogs brjod pas/ thod pa dbang gnyis dam tshig ste// 'phreng ba sngags kyi bdag por brjod// bcu drug thig gi thig btab pa'i// stong pa dbu rgyan zhes byar brjod// a la sogs pa'i ma mo rnams// sangs rgyas zhes bya'i sgra ru 'gyur// de rnams dbus kyi bde ba gang*// de ni gtsug gi nor bur brjod// rigs rnams kun gyi thams cad du// rtag tu dbang bskur de lta bu// thod pa dbang po gnyis/ 'phreng ba de kha sbyor gyi srub pa/ dbu rgyan gyi zhu ba bcu drug phag zhal gyi de stong pas rgyas 'debs pa/ nor bu de lhan skyes rtogs pa'o// thams cad bsdams de lte bar gzhag /dbang po sogs kyi/ padma lte ba'i 'khor lo te// nags sogs a ni ma mo yin// rtsa ba thar pa ster byed pa'i// brda yi sangs rgyas phyag rgya yin// zhes te/ thod pas lta 'khor phreng bar der gnas pa'i dbyangs dang por bshad pa'i phyag chen/ dbu rgyan de so so rang rig pa sangs rgyas de phyin yul yul can gyi dbye ba med pa zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa la gnas pa'o//

de yang sku phebs pa la gsang ba nas snod rung tsam la bum dbang nas rim pas bskur bas brda bzhir 'gro ste dbang bzhi'i dbye bas so// gsung dang thugs phebs na gsum pa dang bzhi pa rim pa bzhin/ gzhan ye shes phebs pa la de nyid kyis chog la/ gzhan spros pa ches/ chung bas 'dul ba la ni/ na ro pas dpal ḍoṃ bhi ba byin gyis brlabs pa bzhin no// zhes padma dkar pos sngar sbyar ba las phyis rgyas par bcos pa yin pas phyin chad 'di kho na bya'o// nges gzung gnam mtha'i spa bkong zhing*// thod brgal mgrin sngon snying 'dod pa// brda yis smin byed dbyar skyes rnga// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rgyud sder grags// gang du byin rlabs char babs shing*// rnam grol myu gu'i skyed drag sar// sku bzhi'i 'bras bu mi bsgug par// log rtog 'brog 'khyams snying rje ba// //rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog padma rā ga'i 'od ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phyar bas rnam par rtog pa'i zug rngu ma lus pa gcod cing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i ros tshim par mdzad pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ thal chen spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ gru mo na yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gcer bu brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas srog bral ba'i snying ga mnan te ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/// /
